steps.name: stamp
argv:
# Stamp EVERY sidecar in the out dir as an unapproved provisional take.
# goblin_ipa_sample.py writes model, prompt, negative, seed, cost_usd 0.00 and
# `scored: false` at render time, and it does NOT write whether the still may
# ship. REFUSES if it found no sidecar -- a run whose provenance files did not
# get written must not pass silently.
import glob, os
out_dir = "C:/banyan-farm/goblin-ipa-0812/out-b02-platescale-0817"
side = sorted(glob.glob(out_dir + "/*.yaml"))
if not side:
    raise SystemExit("!! no sidecar yaml in %s -- refusing to call the job clean." % out_dir)
for p in side:
    with open(p, "a", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as fh:
        fh.write(
            "# --- appended after the render by the sapling-canon anchor lane, 2026-08-17.\n"
            "approved: false\n"
            "provisional: true\n"
            "cost_usd_confirmed: 0\n"
            "note: |\n"
            "  ONE SAMPLE of ONE re-cut draft key (authored_b02_plate_scale_0816). Not a pick,\n"
            "  not a seed confirmation, not approved for any cut. A lane reads the\n"
            "  sixteen frames against THIS BEAT's bar before anything built on it is\n"
            "  filed. Taste and trunk/graft calls are R4's and this run makes none.\n")
print("stamped", len(side), "sidecar(s) in", out_dir)

steps.name: publish
argv:
# THE GLOB CARRIES THE BEAT SLUG (02-the-sprint). Without it the glob matches
# nothing and the step publishes nothing while returning a code that reads like
# a render failure. farm-out is not gitignored, so the runner pushes these itself.
import glob, hashlib, os, shutil
out_dir = "C:/banyan-farm/goblin-ipa-0812/out-b02-platescale-0817"
dst = "C:/banyan-farm/courier-box/farm-out/ep2-b02-platescale-0817"
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
src = sorted(glob.glob(out_dir + "/02-the-sprint-ipa-r*-w015-s*.png")
             + glob.glob(out_dir + "/02-the-sprint-ipa-r*-w015-s*.yaml"))
lines = []
for f in src:
    shutil.copy2(f, dst)
    c = os.path.join(dst, os.path.basename(f))
    with open(c, "rb") as fh:
        h = hashlib.sha256(fh.read()).hexdigest()
    lines.append(h + "  " + os.path.basename(f))
with open(os.path.join(dst, "ep2-b02-platescale-0817.sha256"), "w", newline="\n") as fh:
    fh.write("\n".join(sorted(lines)) + "\n")
print("published", len(src), "file(s) + manifest ->", dst)
raise SystemExit(0 if len(src) >= 16 else 1)
